shortDescription [en_GB]:
The Saucony Peregrine 14 is a high-performance men’s trail running shoe specifically designed for rugged terrain. It’s part of Saucony’s popular Peregrine series known for its durability aggressive traction and responsiveness making it an ideal choice for trail runners who need a reliable and versatile shoe.

Model Details:

  • Model Name: Saucony Peregrine 14 (Men’s Trail Running Shoe)
  • Color: Navy
  • Model Number: S20916-242

Key Features:

  1. Cushioning:
    • The PWRRUN foam cushioning is lightweight yet durable offering a balanced feel between responsiveness and protection. It absorbs impact well providing comfort on uneven rocky terrain.
    • This setup ensures that the shoe feels responsive for faster paces while also protecting the foot on more challenging trails.
  2. Traction:
    • The PWRTRAC outsole comes with aggressive 5mm lugs that deliver excellent grip on both loose and packed surfaces. Whether you’re tackling rocky muddy or slippery trails this outsole provides superior traction.
    • The multi-directional lug pattern ensures secure footing on uphill climbs and downhill descents.
  3. Upper Design:
    • The engineered mesh upper is breathable and lightweight allowing for airflow to keep your feet cool on long runs.
    • Reinforced rock plate in the forefoot area offers additional protection from sharp rocks and debris without compromising flexibility.
    • The upper also includes protective overlays to shield the shoe from wear and tear due to rough terrain.
  4. Fit:
    • FORMFIT technology wraps around the foot providing a snug and adaptive fit. This helps in keeping your foot securely in place even when navigating challenging surfaces.
    • The internal heel counter adds extra support stabilizing the foot during technical runs.
  5. Durability:
    • Built for tough trails the Peregrine 14 is durable enough to handle rough conditions without showing signs of excessive wear.
    • Reinforced toe cap and overlays protect the shoe from abrasions caused by rocks roots and other trail hazards.
  6. Weight:
    • Despite its rugged build the Peregrine 14 is lightweight ensuring it doesn’t feel bulky during long runs. This makes it suitable for both endurance runs and faster-paced trail races.
  7. Heel-to-Toe Drop:
    • Features a 4mm drop giving a low-profile ride that promotes a more natural running feel and better ground feedback especially helpful on technical trails.
  8. Water Resistance:
    • While not waterproof the shoe’s quick-drying upper materials help in managing moisture when running through wet conditions puddles or light rain.

Best For:

  • Trail runners who need a shoe with excellent grip and protection for technical and rugged terrain.
  • Runners looking for a combination of lightweight responsiveness and durability.
  • Ideal for everything from short technical trail runs to long-distance ultra-marathons on tough surfaces.
